Hi — I'm the production manager at our content studio. We have three client shoot briefs sitting in `clients/2026/Q1/client_briefs_q1_2026.json` that need AI-generation prompts built out before the shoots go live.

Can you read through those briefs and generate the right AI art prompts for each one? The tool we use has very specific requirements about how prompts should be structured — the documentation and style guides are in the `docs/` folder and the `SKILL.md` file.

Please save all three completed prompts into a single file called `socialite_prompts.json`. Each entry should clearly identify which brief it belongs to, what style category it falls under, and include the full, ready-to-use prompt string.

I need these to be production-ready — not generic placeholders. The lighting and posing choices in particular need to match the vibe of each brief exactly.
